system.description:
CHANCE CONCENTRATE FOCUS SPIRIT
Action R; Trigger you fail a saving throw
Your Spirit Guide warns, shields or momentarily strengthens you.
Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.
Spirit Intercession is then expended and must be restored through Refocus.
At 7th level, you may also use Spirit Intercession when an ally within 30 feet fails a saving throw. The ally must be capable of benefiting from your Spirit Guide's intervention; Line of Effect is required.

Use as the Reaction: spends the Focus use and the reaction; reroll the failed save (yours, or from 7th an ally's within 30 feet) and keep the better result.
